metadata.method: Contribution = final LR weight per SD x standardized feature value (standardized over the 75,148 historical CVEs). 'vs top 517' subtracts the average contribution among the ensemble's top 517, so the sum over features is how far the CVE's linear score sits below or above a typical selected CVE.
caveats: Attribution covers the logistic-regression voter only. Granite LoRA and LightGBM have no saved per-feature attribution; only their ranks are given.

The final LR weights were fit on all historical CVEs, including these positives. The evaluated ranks came from out-of-fold models. Attribution shows how the team's linear model weighs features, not the exact fold model.
A feature 'holding a CVE back' is a statement about the model's arithmetic, not about whether the CVE was dangerous.
Granite description readings and text features use the description text available to the model; NVD fields labelled retrospective may have been revised after the snapshot.
KEV dates and catalog names are outcomes, not model inputs.
Missing monthly signal rows and zero exploit flags are missing records, not proof of no exploitation.

cohort_contrast.description: Average contribution of each feature, relative to the typical top-517 CVE, for the 43 missed versus the 32 caught KEV positives. Negative 'missed_minus_caught' means the feature pulled the misses down more than the caught cases. Linear voter only.
